subject: general
question: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only one person is sitting between C and D, while considering towards right of D. B is sitting second to the left of D. A is sitting to the immediate right of B. Who is sitting second to the left of E?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given: A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing the centre

Only one person sits between C and D (towards the right of D)

B is second to the left of D

A is immediate right of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/696a37f784038649a2708b6c861df2c9c2cd01e4600b4edf2e2969517c72d4ed.png] 

 

So, second to the left of E is A

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
